import tomllib,subprocess,shlex,json
from pathlib import Path
h=tomllib.loads((Path.home()/'.config/host-ops/config.toml').read_text())['hosts']['termux-phone']
key=Path(h['identity_file']).expanduser()
known=Path.home()/'.cache/photomap-rsync-relay-20261101-v1/adb_usb_known_hosts'
p=subprocess.run(['adb','devices','-l'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
usb=[row.split()[0] for row in p.stdout.splitlines()[1:] if len(row.split())>=2 and row.split()[1]=='device' and ':' not in row.split()[0]]
assert len(usb)==1
f=subprocess.run(['adb','-s',usb[0],'forward','tcp:18122','tcp:8022'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
assert f.returncode==0
try:
 remote=r'''set -u
D="$HOME/Projects/PhotoMap/.dev/termux"
printf 'ACTIVE_MARKER='; test -f "$D/pi-import-active-20261101-v1.json" && echo yes || echo no
printf 'BACKUP='; test -d "$D/rollback-prepi-20261101-v1/data" && echo yes || echo no
printf 'DB_BYTES='; stat -c %s "$D/data/app.db" 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'STAGED_DB='; test -f "$D/import-pi-20261101-v1/data/app.db" && echo yes || echo no
printf 'CURRENT_PRIVATE='; find "$D/storage/private" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l
printf 'CURRENT_PUBLIC='; find "$D/storage/public" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l
printf 'SERVICE='; sv status "$PREFIX/var/service/photomap-dev" || true
for path in /health /api/places/map /; do printf 'PHOTO_%s=' "$path"; curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' "http://127.0.0.1:8010$path" || true; done
printf 'ILESTOI='; curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/health/ready || true
'''
 a=['ssh','-i',str(key),'-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','IdentitiesOnly=yes','-o','StrictHostKeyChecking=yes','-o','UserKnownHostsFile='+str(known),'-o','ConnectTimeout=9','-p','18122',str(h['user'])+'@127.0.0.1','bash -c '+shlex.quote(remote)]
 q=subprocess.run(a,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=130)
 print(json.dumps({'exit':q.returncode,'out':q.stdout[-7000:],'err':q.stderr[-500:]},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
finally:
 subprocess.run(['adb','-s',usb[0],'forward','--remove','tcp:18122'],capture_output=True,timeout=20)
